description: lib/json.fz has a private type_name/1 (five clauses: Tuple, PID, Reference, Reference, Function) and two hand-built Protocol.UndefinedError messages (JSON.Encoder ~206, String.Chars for a key ~279). fz-sc8.149 added the runtime's one answer for a value's kind name (runtime/src/any_value.rs debug::kind_name, used by fz_raise_naming_kind). Fold: expose that name to fz (an extern returning the binary) and delete type_name/1. Not done in fz-sc8.149 because it needs a new runtime export callable from fz, JSON's encoder message carries extra hint text, and type_name's fallthrough names Function. Check that JSON's names for pid/ref stay right (kind_name says Integer for them until fz-xxd.16).
title: JSON's Protocol.UndefinedError messages name the value's kind through the runtime's one answer
